h1: Custom Folding Tote Bags for Easy Storage & Branding
metaTitle: Custom Folding Tote Bags | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom folding tote bags from Perfect Imprints. Compact, portable, and perfect for trade shows, events, and employee gifts.
introHtml: Custom folding tote bags combine everyday utility with space-saving design. Unlike rigid totes, these bags collapse flat or fold into compact pouches, making them ideal for trade shows, conferences, and employee welcome kits. The Zippin Tote zips into a small pouch, while non-woven grocery totes with poly board inserts hold their shape when open yet fold flat for storage. Decorate with your logo using screen printing or full-color transfer for a portable billboard that attendees will keep and reuse.
heroAltText: Custom folding tote bags in various colors, folded and unfolded, with logo imprinting
